deploybot: [prod] Starting deploy window (2024-03-15 22:00-23:00 UTC). Targets: api-service, frontend, routing. Commits: api-service @ a1b2c3d (liam), frontend @ d4e5f6a (ana), routing @ 9f8e7d6 (ranjit). Canary rollout: EU-west.
ana: seeing 95th latency jump on api-service canary +120ms vs baseline.
sara: @deploybot can you post the PR links and commit authors?
deploybot: PRs and authors: api-service https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/512 (liam), frontend https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/201 (ana), routing https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/pull/78 (ranjit). Full SHAs: a1b2c3d4e5f, d4e5f6a7b8c, 9f8e7d6c5b4a.
liam: digging into traces — errors correlated with new batching code in a1b2c3d. Canary error rate ~1.8% vs 0.1% baseline.
olivia: can we do a partial rollback for just api-service and keep frontend/routing at the new SHAs? That should limit impact and preserve change window for the rest.
ranjit: +1. We can pin frontend/routing and rollback api-service to previous stable sha z9y8x7w6v5u. Command: `deployctl rollout set api-service --sha z9y8x7w6v5u --env prod --reason "canary latency spike"`
sara: agree with partial rollback. Notify on-call and customer-facing channels. I'll add a short release note after.
deploybot: [prod] Initiating partial rollback: api-service -> z9y8x7w6v5u. Pinned: frontend=d4e5f6a7b8c, routing=9f8e7d6c5b4a. Rollback job: https://deploy.redwood.ai/jobs/1715556667 (started at 1715556789).
olivia: monitoring dashboards now — looking at p95, error rate, and traces.
deploybot: [prod] Partial rollback complete for api-service. Active sha: z9y8x7w6v5u. Canary metrics: p95 back within normal range, error rate down to 0.12%. Duration: 4m33s.
ana: :thumbsup: good call, latency normalized.
sara: Filing release note: "Partial rollback of api-service (a1b2c3d -> z9y8x7w) after canary latency regression. frontend and routing remain pinned to new release. Investigating batching regression; will reopen rollout when fixed." Will also create incident ticket and link PRs.
ranjit: I'll open a revert PR for the batching change and link here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/513
liam: thanks — I'll run the failing test locally and attach logs to the PR.
deploybot: [prod] Deploy window update: change window still open; api-service rollback completed; frontend/routing pinned. Notifying stakeholders.
